ecosystem_regime_evidence.interpretation: Retained stablecoin capital and spot DEX activity are accelerating materially faster than at the Sep 19 HYPE add checkpoint. Spot DEX growth now exceeds perp growth, improving activity quality versus a leverage-only rally. RWA Active AUM is treated as inventory only; no incremental score is awarded without separate secondary/collateral utilization evidence.

leadership_rotation.price_context: Near fresh all-time high around $95-$96; seven-day price persistence remains positive.
leadership_rotation.relative_quality: Hyperliquid currently shows a cleaner retained-capital/spot-velocity combination than most large chains scanned, while Solana also remains constructive but with slower DEX acceleration.

wallet_quality.fresh_evidence: A fresh wallet received 99,640 HYPE (~$9.36M) from FalconX on Sep 21. A separate wallet, 7bfee.eth, holds about $23.55M in HYPE/HYPE staking assets and moved ~$2.9M HYPE into HyperLend. A long-running 1.38M HYPE leveraged long remains highly profitable, but is derivatives exposure and is discounted.
wallet_quality.independence_assessment: Unverified. FalconX is a common institutional intermediary and does not establish beneficial-owner independence or historical selectivity. The large leveraged long is not counted as clean spot accumulation.
wallet_quality.influencer_risk: CoinGecko surfaced fresh influencer-bullish coverage around HYPE near the ATH; this is treated as crowding/inverse-signal risk rather than confirmation.

narrative_and_product_catalysts.us_expansion: Payward/Kraken is pursuing regulated U.S. access to Hyperliquid HIP-3 markets via compliant infrastructure; launch remains approval-dependent.
narrative_and_product_catalysts.rwa_usage: HIP-3 RWA perpetuals have demonstrated substantial genuine secondary derivative trading historically, but they are synthetic derivatives rather than 1:1 tokenized equity ownership. Q2 reporting cited $213B of RWA perp volume and direct protocol revenue contribution.
narrative_and_product_catalysts.value_capture: Hyperliquid's Assistance Fund is funded from protocol fees and buys HYPE on the open market; an SEC-filed S-1 states 99% of protocol fees are allocated to the Assistance Fund and 47.1M HYPE had been acquired and burned by Sep 8, 2026.

incentive_filter.details: No new points/airdrop campaign explains the broad seven-day stablecoin and spot-volume acceleration. Routine market-maker/referral incentives and derivatives rebates remain discounted.

structural_gate.honeypot_or_transfer_restriction: Not applicable in the same form for native HYPE
structural_gate.supply_concentration: Major caveat: circulating supply remains far below max supply.
structural_gate.unlock_risk: 9.92M HYPE is scheduled to unlock to core contributors on 2026-10-06, roughly 4% of current circulating supply by contemporary estimates.
structural_gate.other: No new hard permission, LP-removal, deployer-dump, or sellability failure identified in this run.

decision.why_it_matters_now: The main quality blockers at the Sep 19 HYPE add checkpoint improved materially: stablecoin retention roughly doubled in growth rate and spot DEX acceleration broadened beyond perps. This is a genuine thesis upgrade.
decision.why_no_add: The portfolio already holds ~5.1% NAV in HYPE. The fresh wallet evidence is not yet historically selective or demonstrably independent, price is at/near a fresh ATH, influencer attention is rising, leveraged HYPE exposure is crowded, and a large core-contributor unlock arrives on Oct 6. Those conditions make scaling to the 7.5% cap unattractive despite the stronger regime evidence.
decision.prospective_add_trigger: Retained stablecoin and spot-Dex growth persist through multiple checkpoints, fresh spot accumulation broadens across independently funded selective wallets, and HYPE absorbs or de-risks the Oct 6 unlock without material distribution/liquidity deterioration.
decision.prospective_trim_trigger: Persistent stablecoin outflows, spot DEX leadership reversal, evidence of contributor distribution around the unlock, or a structural/value-capture failure.

sources.name: SEC S-1 describing Assistance Fund and HYPE supply

framework_notes: No credit is given to pre-signal price appreciation. RWA Active AUM is separated from actual derivative trading activity. Fresh wallet transfers through FalconX are not assumed independent or smart-money until funding/beneficial ownership and historical selectivity are established.
